text:
Rae L: Quick thread for Northstar Bank POC — they're planning to migrate from CompetitorA. They need: a security questionnaire response, a pricing comparison (token vs per-call), webhook signature mapping, and a short parity test plan. Can SEs/security weigh in? cc @Tom C @Ines S
Tom C: They mostly use single-shot completions and embeddings; a few streaming connections for live updates. We should ask for top-200 anonymized requests. Do they require exact token parity or semantic?
Rae L: UX team wants semantic parity; procurement cares about billing deltas.
Ines S: Security asks: EU data residency, SAML SSO, audit logs export, and customer-managed KMS. Hosted supports signature verification and IP allowlist; Dedicated required for customer-managed KMS and mTLS callbacks. I'll attach the mini-Q later.
FinanceBot: Pricing note: we can offer a timeboxed capped POC price. Production will be per-token. Finance needs expected token volume to craft the cap.
Tom C: Proposed test plan: 1) Handshake (day 0-1) validate auth + webhook signatures; 2) Parity smoke (day 2-3) run 500 prompts side-by-side and collect token counts + automated semantic metrics; 3) Billing replay (day 4) estimate delta; 4) Scale (day 5) ramp to p95.
Tom C: Example cURL samples to give them:
```
# session
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/session -d '{"client_id":"NSB-POC","client_secret":"..."}'
# generate
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"Get my last payments"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Ines S: Acceptance criteria suggestion: semantic parity >= 90% on spot-check, token cost delta <= 18% for POC workload, p95 latency < 300ms, webhook success >= 99% with retries. If they insist on mTLS for callbacks, we should propose Dedicated and note lead time.
Rae L: I'll ask Northstar for their questionnaire and sample prompts. Owners: Tom (tech), Ines (security), Rae (sales). Target kickoff next Wed. Anything else?
Tom C: One more: CompetitorA uses header X-CA-Signature. We'll include mapping to X-RW-Signature and a short snippet for their engineers.
Ines S: I'll also prepare a short threat model and IDS rules for callback differences.
Rae L: Thanks team — I'll follow up with Northstar and book the kickoff invite. :thumbsup:
